message.Title: Public Preview: Multi-turn evaluation in Microsoft Foundry

Body.Content:
Multi-turn evaluation is now in public preview in Microsoft Foundry. You can assess complete agent conversations against your quality standards, not only individual responses.

A response can look correct on its own and still be part of a conversation that fails the user. For example, an agent can repeat the same failing action across several turns and leave the request unresolved. Turn-level scores do not show this pattern.

With multi-turn evaluation, you set the evaluation level of a run to score each turn or the conversation as a whole. Conversation-level evaluators, such as task completion, customer satisfaction, coherence, groundedness and tool use quality, find problems like incomplete task resolution, user frustration and tool-call regressions. You provide conversation data as JSONL with a full messages array, including tool calls and tool definitions, and run the evaluation with the Foundry SDK.

Learn more.
